description: CMIP6 cross-model relation between the 1950 to 1980 mean F_ovS at 34.5 S and the forced change of the overturning at 26.5 N (1850 to 1900 to 2081 to 2100, ssp585) and of the streamfunction maximum at 34.5 S; errors-in-variables regressions, rank and partial correlations, family-cluster bootstrap.
error_model: Sampling error of each window mean from interannual variability: standard error about a linear trend with the lag-1 corrected effective sample size (paper3r1_stats.fitted_mean_test). Change errors add the two window errors in quadrature. Deming delta = mean(error variance of y) / mean(error variance of F) over the set; the interannual sensitivity uses the ratio of the mean interannual variances instead.

P1_partial_26N_positive.statement: Given the 1850 to 1900 base state, a more positive F_ovS goes with less weakening at 26.5 N (21 models; family-cluster bootstrap)

P2_partial_26N_fractional_positive.statement: Same, with the fractional change of the overturning at 26.5 N

P3_raw_26N_21_models.statement: Raw correlation of F_ovS with the 26.5 N change, 21 models

P4_raw_26N_common_17_models_negative.statement: Raw correlation of F_ovS with the 26.5 N change on the 17 models with both latitudes (sign opposite to the partial)

P5_raw_34S_19_models_negative.statement: Raw correlation of F_ovS with the 34.5 S change, 19 models (the paper's "absent at 34.5 S" statement concerns the partial only)

P6_partial_34S_not_distinguishable_from_.statement: Partial correlation at 34.5 S given the base state is not distinguishable from zero

P7_partial_26N_minus_34S_contrast.statement: The 26.5 N partial exceeds the 34.5 S partial ("absent at 34.5 S"), paired on the 17 common models

P8_partial_26N_stable_leave_one_model_ou.statement: Partial at 26.5 N keeps its sign when any one model is dropped (21 models)

P9_partial_26N_on_common_17_models.statement: Partial at 26.5 N on the 17 models with both latitudes

P10_errors_in_variables_negligible.statement: Errors in F_ovS (interannual sampling only) do not change the slope: reliability ratio of F_ovS and York versus OLS slope, 21 models, per 0.1 Sv of F_ovS
